scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth

key_metrics.exit_load: Nil (Subject to mandatory 3-year statutory lock-in period)
key_metrics.lock_in: 3 Years mandatory statutory lock-in period from the date of allotment under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act
key_metrics.tax_deduction: Eligible for tax deduction up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year under Section 80C

parsed_sections.Investment Objective: To generate capital appreciation and income from a portfolio of predominantly equity-oriented investments while providing tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
parsed_sections.Lock-in Period & Tax Rules: Statutory lock-in period is 3 years from the date of allotment under Section 80C. No redemption, transfer, or switch-out of units is permitted until the 3-year period expires. Investments qualify for tax deduction up to ₹1,50,000 annually under Section 80C.
parsed_sections.Expense Ratio & Exit Load: Expense ratio is 1.12% (Direct Plan). Exit load is Nil after completion of the 3-year lock-in period.
parsed_sections.Minimum Investment & Riskometer: Minimum SIP is ₹500 and Minimum Lumpsum is ₹500. Riskometer classification is Very High. Benchmark is NIFTY 500 Total Return Index (TRI).
